# Leadsun Seating

> Leadsun Seating is a leading Chinese manufacturer of commercial seating solutions specializing in lecture hall, auditorium, airport terminal, and educational furniture with OEM/ODM customization since 1998.

The company offers comprehensive beam seating, training tables, and fixed seating solutions for higher education institutions, airports, arenas, and commercial spaces. Leadsun combines ergonomic design with durable materials like aluminum alloy and MDF, serving global markets with customizable seating systems.
